rationale: PINS the review-wave G1 gap: `o as String` is the idiomatic Groovy cast but the patched grammar mis-parses it as local_variable_declaration(type_identifier('as'), variable_declarator) — no juxt_function_call exists. The analyzer must still emit a cast_type reference to String (and Set for `[] as Set`). The `as` keyword itself must never become an edge target. C-style `(String) o` stays pinned by cast-types.
